climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A red Piedmont DOCG made from Nebbiolo grown in the hills of Gattinara commune, in Vercelli province. It became a DOC. Its rules also allow Uva Rara and Vespolina.
